title: Cognitive Constraints and Misspecification Concern
abstract: arXiv:2611.25368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study repeated decision problems in which an agent has cognitive constraints and is concerned that her models might be misspecified. She first uses data to weight candidate models, subject to a cognitive-capacity constraint on the complexity she can process, and then she evaluates choices according to how well they perform under those models. More data need not overcome limited capacity: a statistically inferior but simpler model can remain relevant in the long run. When the constraint binds, evidence that favors models in proportion to their complexity can leave current behavior unchanged while still affecting later responses to data. This constraint eliminates cycles between risky and safe actions when simple models favor safety, and relaxing it can make risky play more attractive initially yet less frequent in the long run. It can also sustain misspecified model classes by suppressing choices that would reveal their errors.

translated_title: 认知约束与模型误设担忧
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一类重复决策问题，其中决策者存在认知约束，并担心自己的模型可能存在误设。她首先利用数据对各候选模型赋予权重，但受到认知容量的限制（即所能处理的复杂程度有限），然后根据各选择在这些模型下的表现来评估决策。更多的数据未必能克服有限的能力：一个统计上较差但更简单的模型可能长期保持相关性。当约束生效时，按与模型复杂度成比例的方式支持各模型的证据，可能使当前行为保持不变，但仍会影响其后续对数据的反应。当简单模型偏好安全选项时，这一约束能够消除风险行为与安全行为之间的循环；而放松该约束可能使冒险行为在初期更具吸引力，但长期来看出现频率反而更低。认知约束还可能通过抑制那些会暴露模型错误的选择，从而使误设的模型类别得以延续。
tldr: 该论文研究存在认知约束且担忧模型误设的重复决策问题，发现有限的认知能力会让更简单的（即使统计上较差的）模型长期保持影响力，从而消除风险与安全行为之间的循环，并可能通过抑制会暴露错误的选择来维持误设的模型类别。
en_tdlr: This paper studies repeated decision problems with cognitive constraints and misspecification concern, showing that limited cognitive capacity keeps simpler (even statistically inferior) models relevant in the long run, eliminates risky-safe action cycles, and can sustain misspecified model classes by suppressing choices that would reveal their errors.
